subject: Recap + choose a 30-min slot for the initial product brief
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alison Park <alison.park@lumenai.com>, Mike Torres <mike.torres@lumenai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + pick a 30-min slot for a product brief

Hi Alison / Mike —

Thanks again for the chat today — appreciate you walking through the key goals and the data flows. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost while keeping 1x latency target for your customer-facing recommendation engine.
- Nice-to-have: offline batch embedding pipeline and a short-term plan for rollback/fallback during A/B testing.
- Main constraint: must run inside your VPC or a private deployment option; security questionnaire forthcoming.

To keep momentum, would you be open to a focused 30-minute product brief where we: 1) demo the hosted + private options, 2) show a short technical plan for migration, and 3) confirm next steps for trial sizing?

Here are three windows (all PT) — pick one or suggest two alternates that work for your stakeholders:

- Tue, Sep 27 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed, Sep 28 — 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu, Sep 29 — 09:00–09:30 PT

For the session it would be helpful if you could include: your infra lead (networking/VPC), the PM who owns the recommendation model, and someone who can speak to retention/compliance requirements.

I attached a short PDF with the discovery notes and a simple agenda. If none of the above windows work, I can open up a Calendly poll.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: discovery-notes-20260920.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

Wed 14:00–14:30 PT won't work for us that week, but two times that look possible on our side are:

- Wed, Sep 29 — 11:00–11:30 PT
- Thu, Sep 30 — 09:00–09:30 PT

Can you confirm whether your brief will include a short section on data retention and network controls? We'll need that for our security team to decide whether to move to a trial.

If you can do Wed 11:00 that would be ideal — we can add our infra lead then.

Best,
Alison Park
Head of Product, LumenAI
alison.park@lumenai.com
